Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp

Class BasicMcpSubscriptionBroker

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.BasicMcpSubscriptionBroker
All Implemented Interfaces:
McpSubscriptionBroker, McpSubscriptions
public class BasicMcpSubscriptionBroker extends Object implements McpSubscriptionBroker
Default McpSubscriptionBroker: a ConcurrentHashMap-backed registry doing filtered fan-out.

Publish methods (resourceUpdated(java.lang.String), toolsListChanged(), promptsListChanged(), resourcesListChanged()) build one McpChangeEvent and iterate the live registry, offering the event only to subscriptions whose McpSubscriptionFilter.matches(McpChangeEvent) returns true — this never broadcasts unconditionally the way org.apache.juneau.rest.server.sse.SseBroadcaster#publish does.

    • registerIfUnder

      public Optional<McpSubscription> registerIfUnder(int max, String subscriptionId, McpSubscriptionFilter honoredFilter)
      Description copied from interface: McpSubscriptionBroker
      Atomically admission-checks against max and registers, closing the TOCTOU window a separate McpSubscriptionBroker.activeCount() check plus McpSubscriptionBroker.register(java.lang.String, org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.McpSubscriptionFilter) call would leave open under concurrent callers (in particular against a JVM-wide shared broker instance, where unrelated callers race each other).

      Re-registering an id that is already present is always allowed and never counted against max, matching McpSubscriptionBroker.register(java.lang.String, org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.McpSubscriptionFilter)'s replace-on-same-id semantics (the previous subscription with that id is closed) — a replacement does not grow McpSubscriptionBroker.activeCount(), so it cannot be what pushes the registry over the cap.

      Specified by:
      registerIfUnder in interface McpSubscriptionBroker
      Parameters:
      max - The maximum number of concurrently active subscriptions to admit under (exclusive: a request is admitted only while McpSubscriptionBroker.activeCount() is strictly less than this, except for the same-id replacement case above).
      subscriptionId - The subscription identifier (the listen request's JSON-RPC id). Must not be null or empty.
      honoredFilter - The capability-gated filter this subscription honors. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      The new subscription handle, or Optional.empty() if the cap was reached and this was not a same-id replacement.
